description_en: Queries basic information about a gateway, such as its status and type, based on the specified gateway ID
description_zh: 根据指定网关ID查询网关的基本信息。包括网关状态、类型等详情
name: DescribeGateway

ActivatedTime.description_en: The time when the gateway was activated. This value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of seconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC
ActivatedTime.description_zh: 网关激活时间。时间戳为秒（s）

BuyURL.description_en: The purchase URL of the subscription gateway if the payment is not complete
BuyURL.description_zh: 未完成支付情况下，预付费的购买支付链接

Category.description_en: The category of the gateway. The default value is `Aliyun`

Code.description_en: The status code. A status code of 200 indicates that the request was successful
Code.description_zh: 状态码。状态码为200表示请求成功

CommonBuyInstanceId.description_en: The ID of the subscription gateway instance in the sales system
CommonBuyInstanceId.description_zh: 包年包月网关在售卖系统中的实例ID

CreatedTime.description_en: The time when the gateway was created. This value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of seconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC
CreatedTime.description_zh: 网关创建时间。时间戳为秒（s）

EcsInstanceId.description_en: The ID of the ECS instance

ElasticNode.description_en: The IP address of the elastic gateway node

ExpireStatus.description_en:
The expiration status of the subscription gateway. Valid values:

0: The gateway is normal.
1: The gateway is about to expire.
2: The gateway has expired
ExpireStatus.description_zh:
预付费情况下，网关是否过期的状态。可能值：

0：正常

1：将要过期
 
2：已经过期

ExpiredTime.description_en: The time when the subscription gateway expires. This value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC
ExpiredTime.description_zh: 预付费情况下，网关的过期时间，时间戳为毫秒（ms）

GatewayClass.description_en:
The gateway class. This parameter is returned if the gateway is a cloud gateway. Valid values:

Basic: Basic
Standard: Standard
Enhanced: Enhanced
Advanced: Performance
GatewayClass.description_zh:
网关规格。当网关为线上网关时会返回网关规格。可能值如下：

Basic：基础型

Standard：标准型

Enhanced：增强型

Advanced：性能型

GatewayType.description_en:
The type of the gateway. Valid values:

File: file gateway
Iscsi: iSCSI gateway
GatewayType.description_zh:
网关类型，可能值如下：

File：文件网关

Iscsi：块网关

HighAvailability.description_en: Indicates whether the gateway is a high availability (HA) gateway

InnerIp.description_en: The IP address used for mounting

IsPostPaid.description_en:
Indicates whether the gateway is a pay-as-you-go gateway. Valid values:

true: The gateway is a pay-as-you-go gateway.
false: The gateway is a subscription gateway
IsPostPaid.description_zh:
是否为后付费网关。可能值如下：

true：后付费网关，即按量付费网关。

false：预付费网关，即包年包月网关

IsReleaseAfterExpiration.description_en:
Indicates whether the subscription gateway is automatically released after it expires. Valid values:

true: The gateway is automatically released after it expires.
false: The gateway is automatically converted to a pay-as-you-go gateway after it expires
IsReleaseAfterExpiration.description_zh:
预付费情况下，是否到期释放。可能值如下：

true：到期自动释放，直接收回。

false：预付费到期后自动转为按量付费模式

Location.description_en:
The location of the gateway. Valid values:

Cloud: cloud gateway
On_Premise: on-premises gateway
Location.description_zh:
网关位置。可能值如下：

Cloud：线上网关

On_Premise：线下网关

PublicNetworkBandwidth.description_en: The public bandwidth. Unit: Mbit/s. If the gateway is a cloud gateway, the public bandwidth is returned
PublicNetworkBandwidth.description_zh: 数据公网带宽，单位为Mbps。如果网关为线上网关返回数据公网带宽

RenewURL.description_en: The renewal URL of the subscription gateway
RenewURL.description_zh: 预付费情况下的续费链接

SecondaryVSwitchId.description_en: The ID of the vSwitch for the secondary node of the HA gateway
SecondaryVSwitchId.description_zh: 高可用网关备节点虚拟交换机ID

Status.description_en:
The status of the gateway. Valid values:

Initialized: The gateway is initialized.
Deactivated: The gateway is inactive.
Activated: The gateway is active.
Deploying: The gateway is being deployed.
Running: The gateway is running.
Stopping: The gateway is being stopped.
Stopped: The gateway is stopped.
Starting: The gateway is being started.
Rebooting: The gateway is being restarted.
Deleting: The gateway is being deleted.
Failed: The gateway failed.
Upgrading: The gateway is being upgraded.
Modifying: The gateway is being modified.
Unknown: The gateway has no heartbeat for a long time
Status.description_zh:
网关状态。可能值如下：

Initialized：已初始化

Deactivated：未激活

Activated：已激活

Deploying：部署中

Running：运行中

Stopping：停止中

Stopped：已停止

Starting：启动中

Rebooting：重启中

Deleting：删除中

Failed：失败

Upgrading：升级中

Modifying：修改中

Unknown：长时间没有心跳

StorageBundleId.description_en: The ID of the gateway cluster

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true: The request was successful.
false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功。可能值如下：

true：是

false：否
